[b]Tired of losing 1,000g to Joja Mart or getting a letter from Linus because you stayed out too late mining?
[/b]
[b]Go To Bed[/b] is a simple Quality of Life mod that ensures you never pass out outside your home again. It acts as a safety net for players who lose track of time while fishing, mining, or farming.

[center]﻿[/center][b][color=#00ffff]✨ Features
[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Warning Message:[/b] At [b]1:20 AM[/b], you will receive a notification HUD message: "You will be teleported home soon. Please be ready..."
[/list][list]
[*][b]Auto-Teleport:[/b] At [b]1:40 AM[/b] (just before the 2:00 AM pass-out time), the mod instantly teleports you safely inside your Farmhouse.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Fully Configurable:[/b] Change the times, the warning message, or even the warp location.
[/list][list=1]


[center][youtube]hplcljo3oyU[/youtube][/center][/list][line][b][color=#00ffff]⚙️ How to Configure (Settings)
[/color][/b]
After you run the game with the mod installed at least once, a config.json file will be created in the mod's folder. You can open this file with any text editor (like Notepad) to change the settings.

Understanding Stardew TimeStardew Valley uses a specific format for time in the code. If you change the times, you must use these numbers:

[list]
[*]600 = 6:00 AM
[*]1200 = 12:00 PM (Noon)
[*]2400 = 12:00 AM (Midnight)
[*]2500 = 1:00 AM
[*]2540 = 1:40 AM
[*]2600 = 2:00 AM
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40691/40691-1767986712-2623300.png[/img]﻿[b][color=#00ffff]Config Options
[/color][/b]
Here is what the settings in config.json do:

[list]
[*][b]WarpTime[/b]: (Default: 2540)
[/list][list]
The time the teleport happens. 2540 equals 1:40 AM.[*][b]WarningTime[/b]: (Default: 2520)
[/list][list]
The time the warning message appears. 2520 equals 1:20 AM.[*][b]WarningMessage[/b]:
[/list][list]
The text displayed on the screen. You can change this to whatever you want![*][b]TargetLocation[/b]: (Default: "FarmHouse")
[/list][list]
Where you get teleported. "FarmHouse" is the inside of your home.[*][b]TargetX[/b] & [b]TargetY[/b]: (Default: 3, 10) 
The specific tile coordinates where you land. The default lands you right by the door inside the starter farmhouse.[b][color=#00ffff]
[/color][/b][/list]Example:
[list]
Making it trigger earlierIf you want to be warped home at [b]Midnight (12:00 AM)[/b] instead, change your config to look like this:{  "WarpTime": 2400,  "WarningTime": 2340,  "WarningMessage": "It is midnight! Warping home in 20mins...",  "TargetLocation": "FarmHouse",  "TargetX": 3,  "TargetY": 10}[list]
